answers.core: The engine itself exposes the type information of its API.
answers.workaround: Not in script, but it can be worked around by individual GDExtension bindings. This would however mean all APIs need to be manually special-cased, and that effort would need to be replicated for each binding, rather than once in Godot.

title: Improve integer and float consistency (32/64-bit, signed/unsigned, float/double)
